# Importing Count Data

```{r}
# import libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(org.Mm.eg.db)
  library(hgu95av2.db)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(lubridate)
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

```{r}
# reads csv data into a variable called counts and skips the first header line
counts <- read.csv("/work/clh162/Data+/Sophie/2025-2026-team-code-sac165/Data+_team/Sophie/gene_counts/gene_counts.csv", skip = 1, check.names = FALSE, row.names = 1)

# remove the full path, .bam extension, and job id/array task id in the column names to just extract the sample names
sample_names <- basename(colnames(counts)[6:ncol(counts)])
sample_names <- sub("_sorted\\.bam", "", sample_names)
sample_names <- sub("^(.*_Gill).*", "\\1", sample_names)
colnames(counts)[6:ncol(counts)] <- sample_names

# set the column names to just the sample names
count_matrix <- counts[, 6:ncol(counts)]
colnames(count_matrix)

# gives number of rows and number of columns
dim(count_matrix)

# save count_matrix
write.table(
  count_matrix,
  file = "/work/clh162/Data+/Sophie/2025-2026-team-code-sac165/Data+_team/Sophie/gene_counts_clean.txt",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = TRUE,
  col.names = NA
)
```

```{r}
# read in sample annotations and match the column names of the count matrix to the row names of the column data (make sure the sample names are the same and in the same positions)
col_data <- read.csv("/work/clh162/Data+/Sophie/2025-2026-team-code-sac165/Data+_team/Sophie/xRNA_clean.csv", row.names = 2) 
col_data <- col_data[match(colnames(count_matrix), rownames(col_data)), ]

# read in gene annotations
gene_annotation_gtf <- read.delim("/work/clh162/OysterRNA24/hisat2_align/Cv_genome_RU_2025_shared/Cvi_RU25.gtf", comment.char = "#", header = FALSE, sep = "\t", quote = "")

# name the columns and get gene_id from attribute column
names(gene_annotation_gtf) <- c("seqname", "source", "feature", "start", "end", "score", "strand", "frame", "attribute")
table(gene_annotation_gtf$feature)
transcripts <- gene_annotation_gtf[gene_annotation_gtf$feature == "transcript",]
transcripts$gene_id <- sub('.*gene_id "([^"]+)".*', '\\1', transcripts$attribute)
head(transcripts$gene_id)

# create gene annotation object
row_ranges <- transcripts[, c("gene_id", "seqname", "start", "end", "strand", "feature", "attribute")]
rownames(row_ranges) <- row_ranges$gene_id

# match the row names of the count matrix to the row names of the row ranges
row_ranges <- row_ranges[match(rownames(count_matrix), rownames(row_ranges)), ]
```

```{r}
# make sure samples are in the same order
all.equal(colnames(count_matrix), rownames(col_data))

# make sure genes are in the same order
all.equal(rownames(count_matrix), rownames(row_ranges))
```

```{r}
# convert row_ranges data frame to GRanges object
row_ranges <- GRanges(seqnames = row_ranges$seqname, 
                      ranges = IRanges(
                        start = row_ranges$start,
                        end = row_ranges$end),
                      strand = row_ranges$strand,
                      gene_id = row_ranges$gene_id)
```

# Create SummarizedExperiment Object

```{r}
# create SummarizedExperiment object
se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(count_matrix = as.matrix(count_matrix)), 
                            rowRanges = row_ranges,
                            colData = col_data)
```

# Create DESeqDataSet Object

```{r}
# convert SummarizedExperiment object to DESeqDataSet object
dds = DESeqDataSet(se, design = ~ Location)

# remove rows with low gene counts (keep rows that have at least 10 reads total)
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >=3
dds <- dds[keep,]

# set the factor level, let DAF (Duke Aquafarm) be reference
dds$Location = relevel(dds$Location, ref = "DAF")
```

# Run DESeq2

```{r}
dds <- DESeq(dds)
results <- results(dds)

# summary results
summary(results)

results0.01 <- results(dds, alpha = 0.01) # with smaller p-value
summary(results0.01)

# contrasts (find info about comparisons made)
resultsNames(dds)
```

# MA Plot

```{r}
plotMA(results)
```

# PCA Plot

```{r}
# transform dds into varianced-stabilized dataset (vsd)
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)

# plot
pcaData <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "Location", returnData = TRUE)
ggplot(pcaData, 
       aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Location, label = name)) + geom_point(size = 3) + geom_text(vjust = -1, size = 2)
```

# Gene Expression Heatmap

```{r}
results_ordered <- results[order(results$padj), ]
top_genes <- rownames(results_ordered)[1:50] # order results and get the top genes based on adjusted p-value (top 50 lowest p-values = top 50 most statistically significant genes)
mat <- assay(vsd)[top_genes, ] # get expression values
mat <- t(scale(t(mat))) # scale each gene
heatmap_annotation <- HeatmapAnnotation(Location = colData(vsd)$Location)
Heatmap(mat,
        name = "Expression",
        top_annotation = heatmap_annotation,
        show_row_names = FALSE, # can change if want to see gene ids
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        cluster_columns = TRUE)
```

# PCA plot also taking month into account
```{r}
# changes characters into dates
col_data$Date_Collected <- dmy(col_data$Date_Collected)

# creates month variable and makes it a column in col_data
col_data$Month <- factor(
  as.character(month(col_data$Date_Collected,
                     label = TRUE,
                     abbr = FALSE)),
  levels = c("June", "July", "August"),
  ordered = FALSE
)

colData(se)$Month <- col_data$Month

colData(vsd)$Month <- col_data$Month

# create PCA plot with month and location
pcaData_month <- plotPCA(
    vsd,
    intgroup = c("Location", "Month"),
    returnData = TRUE
)

ggplot(pcaData_month, 
       aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Month, shape = Location)) + geom_point(size = 3)
```

# Create new DESeqDataSet object with month
```{r}
dds_time <- DESeqDataSet(
    se,
    design = ~ Location * Month
)

# set DAF as the reference
dds_time$Location <- relevel(dds_time$Location, ref = "DAF")

# create new object with likelihood ratio test (LRT) between simpler model (just location) and more complex model (location and month)
#  dds_time <- DESeq(
#     dds_time,
#     test = "LRT",
#     reduced = ~ Location
# )

# filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds_time) >= 10) >=3
dds_time <- dds_time[keep,]
dds_time # 21981 genes

# run DESeq2
dds_time <- DESeq(dds_time)

results_time <- results(dds_time)

top_month_genes <- rownames(results_time)[order(results_time$padj)][1:12]

vsd_time <- vst(dds_time, blind = FALSE)

# fix months
colData(vsd_time)$CollectionDate <- as.Date(col_data$Date_Collected)
colData(vsd_time)$Month <- factor(
  format(colData(vsd_time)$CollectionDate, "%B"),
  levels = c("June", "July", "August")
)

plot_df <- data.frame(
  Gene = rep(top_month_genes, times = ncol(vsd_time)),
  Expression = as.vector(assay(vsd_time)[top_month_genes, ]),
  Month = rep(colData(vsd_time)$Month, each = length(top_month_genes)),
  Location = rep(colData(vsd_time)$Location, each = length(top_month_genes)),
  Sample = rep(colnames(vsd_time), each = length(top_month_genes))
)

# faceted line plot for top twelve genes ordered by month/time
ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = Month,
           y = Expression,
           color = Location,
           group = Location)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "line",
               linewidth = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "point",
               size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "VST-normalized expression",
       x = "Month")
```

# DESeq2 Results Subset by Month
```{r}
# june
results_june <- results(
  dds_time,
  alpha = 0.05,
  name = "Location_CMT_vs_DAF")

# july
results_july <- results(
  dds_time,
  alpha = 0.05,
  contrast = list(
    c("Location_CMT_vs_DAF", "LocationCMT.MonthJuly")
  )
)

# august
results_august <- results(
  dds_time,
  alpha = 0.05,
  contrast = list(
    c("Location_CMT_vs_DAF", "LocationCMT.MonthAugust")
  )
)
```

# Pairwise Comparison MA Plots (DAF vs. CMT for each month)
```{r}
# june
plotMA(results_june, main = "CMT vs. DAF - June", ylim = c(-5, 5))

# july
plotMA(results_july, main = "CMT vs. DAF - July", ylim = c(-5, 5))

# august
plotMA(results_august, main = "CMT vs. DAF - August", ylim = c(-5, 5))

# count significant genes per month (shows how much divergence exists between locations each month)
sum(results_june$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
sum(results_july$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
sum(results_august$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

# determine if the different significant genes are consistent each month
# get significant genes
sig_june <- rownames(results_june)[which(results_june$padj < 0.05)]
sig_july <- rownames(results_july)[which(results_july$padj < 0.05)]
sig_august <- rownames(results_august)[which(results_august$padj < 0.05)]
# count genes that are consistently significant across all three months
length(Reduce(intersect,
              list(sig_june, sig_july, sig_august)))

Reduce(intersect,
              list(sig_june, sig_july, sig_august))

length(intersect(sig_june, sig_july))
length(intersect(sig_june, sig_august))
length(intersect(sig_july, sig_august))

```

# Pairwise Comparison Volcano Plots (DAF vs. CMT for each month)
```{r}
library(tibble)

# volcano plot function
plot_volcano <- function(res, title) {

  df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene_id")

  df$Significant <- with(
    df,
    padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1
  )
  
  label_genes <- df %>%
  filter(
    padj < 1e-7,
    abs(log2FoldChange) > 2
  )

  ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      log2FoldChange,
      -log10(padj),
      color = Significant
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(-1, 1),
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("grey70", "red")
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    ggtitle(title) #+
    #geom_text_repel(
      #data = label_genes,
      #aes(label = gene_id)
    #)
}

# june
plot_volcano(
  results_june,
  "CMT vs. DAF - June"
)

# july
plot_volcano(
  results_july,
  "CMT vs. DAF - July"
)

# august
plot_volcano(
  results_august,
  "CMT vs. DAF - August"
)
```

# Generate lists of total significant upregulated and downregulated gene ids
```{r}
# NOTE: I am defining "significant" as padj < 0.05 and absolute value of log2FoldChange > 0

results_df <- as.data.frame(results)

# get list of upregulated gene ids
upregulated_genes <- subset(results_df, padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0)
upregulated_gene_ids <- rownames(upregulated_genes)
upregulated_gene_ids

# get list of downregulated gene ids
downregulated_genes <- subset(results_df, padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0)
downregulated_gene_ids <- rownames(downregulated_genes)
downregulated_gene_ids
```

# Counting upregulated and downregulated genes for each location and month
```{r}
# NOTE: upregulated means more expressed in CMT than DAF and downregulated means less expressed in CMT than DAF (aka more expressed in DAF than CMT)
# june
upregulated_june_counts <- sum(
  results_june$padj < 0.05 &
    results_june$log2FoldChange > 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

downregulated_june_counts <- sum(
  results_june$padj < 0.05 &
    results_june$log2FoldChange < 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# july
upregulated_july_counts <- sum(
  results_july$padj < 0.05 &
    results_july$log2FoldChange > 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

downregulated_july_counts <- sum(
  results_july$padj < 0.05 &
    results_july$log2FoldChange < 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# august
upregulated_august_counts <- sum(
  results_august$padj < 0.05 &
    results_august$log2FoldChange > 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

downregulated_august_counts <- sum(
  results_august$padj < 0.05 &
    results_august$log2FoldChange < 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# put counts into table
table <- data.frame(
  Month = c("June", "July", "August"),
  Up_in_CMT = c(upregulated_june_counts, upregulated_july_counts, upregulated_august_counts),
  Up_in_DAF = c(downregulated_june_counts, downregulated_july_counts, downregulated_august_counts)
)
table
```

# Environmental Data
```{r}
# load in all environmental data files for summer 2024
ph <- read_excel("/work/clh162/Data+/Sophie/2025-2026-team-code-sac165/pH_2024.xlsx")
salinity <- read_excel("/work/clh162/Data+/Sophie/2025-2026-team-code-sac165/Salinity_2024.xlsx")
do <- read_excel("/work/clh162/Data+/Sophie/2025-2026-team-code-sac165/DOsensor_2024.xlsx")
precip <- read_excel("/work/clh162/Data+/Sophie/2025-2026-team-code-sac165/Precip_2024.xlsx")

# standardize dates
ph$DateTime <- as.Date(ph$DateTime)
salinity$DateTime <- as.Date(salinity$DateTime)
do$DateTime <- as.Date(do$DateTime)
precip$DateTime <- as.Date(precip$DateTime)

# create variable for sample collection dates
col_data$CollectionDate <- as.Date(col_data$Date_Collected)
```

# Salinity
```{r}
# calculate 7-day average for the 7 days before the collection dates
salinity <- salinity %>%
  mutate(Farm = recode(Farm, "DUML" = "DAF", "CMAST" = "CMT"))

salinity_avg <- salinity %>%
  group_by(Farm) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    sample_dates <- sort(unique(
      col_data$CollectionDate[col_data$Location == .y$Farm]
    ))
    data.frame(
      CollectionDate = sample_dates,
      Salinity_7d_Avg = sapply(
        sample_dates, 
        function(date){
          mean(.x$Sal_ppt[.x$DateTime >= date - 7 & .x$DateTime <= date], na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      )
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(Location = Farm)


salinity_avg

# add to environmental data table
env_data <- left_join(
  col_data,
  salinity_avg,
  by = c("Location", "CollectionDate"))

# calculate correlation coefficients
salinity_correlation <- sapply(
  top_month_genes,
  function(gene)
    cor(
      assay(vsd_time)[gene, ],
      env_data$Salinity_7d_Avg,
      method = "spearman"
    )
)
salinity_correlation

# create PCA plot for salinity and location
pcaData$Salinity <- env_data$Salinity_7d_Avg
pcaData$Location <- env_data$Location

ggplot(
  pcaData,
  aes(
    PC1,
    PC2,
    color = Salinity,
    shape = Location
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  theme_classic()
```

pcaData$pH <- env_data$pH_7d_Avg
pcaData$Location <- env_data$Location

ggplot(

# Dissolved Oxygen
```{r}
# calculate 7-day average for the 7 days before the collection dates
do <- do %>%
  mutate(Farm = recode(Farm, "DUML" = "DAF", "CMAST" = "CMT"))

do_avg <- do %>%
  group_by(Farm) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    sample_dates <- sort(unique(
      col_data$CollectionDate[col_data$Location == .y$Farm]
    ))
    data.frame(
      CollectionDate = sample_dates,
      DO_7d_Avg = sapply(
        sample_dates, 
        function(date){
          mean(.x$DomgL[.x$DateTime >= date - 7 & .x$DateTime <= date], na.rm = TRUE)
        }
      )
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(Location = Farm)

do_avg

# add to environmental data table
env_data <- left_join(
  env_data,
  do_avg,
  by = c("Location", "CollectionDate"))

# calculate correlation coefficients
do_correlation <- sapply(
  top_month_genes,
  function(gene)
    cor(
      assay(vsd_time)[gene, ],
      env_data$DO_7d_Avg,
      method = "spearman",
      use = "complete.obs"
    )
)
all(colnames(vsd_time) == env_data$Sample)
do_correlation

# create PCA plot for dissolved oxygen and location
pcaData$DO <- env_data$DO_7d_Avg
pcaData$Location <- env_data$Location

ggplot(
  pcaData,
  aes(
    PC1,
    PC2,
    color = DO,
    shape = Location
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  theme_classic()
```

# Further Environmental Data Analysis - Temperature 
```{r}
# I am choosing to graph gene expression and temperature vs month on the same plot for the gene with the highest correlation coefficient (evm.TU.Chr04.3052)
gene <- "evm.TU.Chr04.3052"

plot_df <- data.frame(
  Date = env_data$CollectionDate,
  Location = env_data$Location,
  Expression = assay(vsd_time)[gene, ],
  Temperature = env_data$Temp_7d_Avg
)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(Date, color = Location)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Expression), size = 3) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(y = Expression, group = Location, linetype = "Gene Expression"),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = Temperature, group = interaction(Location, "Temperature"), linetype = "Temperature"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(y = Temperature),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Variable",
    values = c(
      "Gene Expression" = "solid",
      "Temperature" = "twodash"
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    y = "Value",
    title = gene
  )
```
